material.description:
Measured with CDP device emulation on the live owner page (commit cdad85f6). At 375 by 667 the top-left status, the team gold strip, the room list and the lobby buttons draw over each other, and the skills panel covers most of the viewport; there is no horizontal overflow and no page error. At 768 by 1024, 1280 by 720 and 1920 by 1080 the layout fits. Screenshot: /tmp/device-phone.png. Fix: a compact layout below about 600 px wide (panels stacked or collapsed), and a witness at 375 by 667 with the same probe (scripts/dev/peer-probe.mjs pattern).

Drain-e-1 update: lobby overlap fixed in 24a4fa59c56352b6cfd6b8862bc9c22cd5e83f1e (js/client/play.html phone block, js/client/widgets.js phone block). CI green on that sha (runs 40099486637, 40099486678). Witness dispatch 1792850232599-2951-53232e2296c0faad (fresh load, CDP 375x667, 768x1024, 1280x720, 1920x1080): no overlap in #ui-left, #ui-right, #ui-top, #ui-bar, lobby, buttons at any size; no horizontal overflow; zero Runtime.exceptionThrown. Before: /workspace/oscraft/.gm/witness/device-phone-375-before.png (dispatch 1792849357669-2359-f7231c35c3204e76). After: /workspace/oscraft/.gm/witness/device-phone-375-after.png. Remaining, not witnessed: the in-game skills panel at 375 (it renders only with a hero). blocked_by: device-phone-layout-overlap-375-blocker-drain-e-1.
